name: From My Heart
message: You are genuinely my entire universe in this world. Seeing you smile effortlessly is my favorite sight in life. Harleen 4 life 🌸

name: Little Reminder
message: Nothing makes me happier than seeing you genuinely smile. Every little laugh of yours makes everything around you so much better. Never forget how special you are ✨

name: Midnight Thought
message: In a world full of noise, you bring a quiet peace I can't find anywhere else. Thank you for existing, Harleen. Always here for you 🌙

name: My Favorite Person
message: If I could give you one thing in life, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes — so you'd know just how truly rare and adored you are 🎀
